changelog:
Lighter on your PC while it transcribes.

Speech-to-text now runs in its own low-priority process and uses a quarter of your CPU cores instead of all of them; the meeting summary uses the same limit. Transcription takes a little longer, but the rest of your PC stays responsive.

Fixed: while the speech model was loading, DensAssistant could stop responding for up to 40 seconds, so the dashboard and phone sync briefly failed to connect. It now keeps answering the whole time, and when the speech model unloads, all of its memory goes back to Windows.
